skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Hear one sound in different spellings
skills.learning_objective: Identifies words where the same letters make an unusual sound, or different letters make the same sound, and sorts them by sound.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Read common words on sight, including words that sound alike
skills.learning_objective: Reads common words quickly and chooses the right one of two words that sound alike or nearly alike, by its meaning in the sentence.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Break a long word into parts to read it
skills.learning_objective: Reads an unfamiliar long word by splitting it into syllables or known parts, and uses the sentence to check it makes sense.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell the j and k sounds the right way
skills.learning_objective: Writes the /j/ sound as j, g, ge or dge and the /k/ sound as c, k or ck, choosing by the letters around it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Add -s, -ed and -ing to verbs
skills.learning_objective: Writes verbs with -s, -ed and -ing, dropping a final e before -ing and doubling the last consonant after a short vowel.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell words with re-, in-, -ment, -ness and -less
skills.learning_objective: Writes words that add re-, in-, -ment, -ness or -less to a root word, changing y to i where the rule needs it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Choose to, two or too, and right or write
skills.learning_objective: Chooses and writes the homophone that matches the meaning of the sentence: to, two or too; right or write; and other common pairs.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Tell fiction from non-fiction
skills.learning_objective: Sorts books and short extracts into fiction and non-fiction, and places each on the right library shelf from its subject.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Name a story's kind from its features
skills.learning_objective: Identifies a story as a fable, adventure, myth, mystery or funny story from its typical features, and compares two kinds.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Read short forms like isn't and we're
skills.learning_objective: Reads a short form with an apostrophe and says the two words it stands for, and finds which letters the apostrophe replaces.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write short forms with an apostrophe
skills.learning_objective: Writes the short form of two words with the apostrophe in the place of the missing letters.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: End a sentence with a full stop, question mark or exclamation mark
skills.learning_objective: Writes the right end mark for each sentence, and a capital letter at the start of the next.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Tell statements, questions, commands and exclamations apart
skills.learning_objective: Identifies each sentence as a statement, question, command or exclamation from its words and its end mark, and reads it with that meaning.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find facts the passage states
skills.learning_objective: Finds information stated in a passage by scanning for a key word, and answers a question by copying or pointing to the words that say it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say how the writer shows a character or a place
skills.learning_objective: Finds the words that tell what a character is like or what a place is like, and explains what they show.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Put the events of a story in order
skills.learning_objective: Orders the events of a story or recount and says which earlier event caused a later one.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Choose a book from its blurb
skills.learning_objective: Chooses a book for a reader from its blurb or a short review and explains the choice with one detail.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Plan the main points before writing
skills.learning_objective: Plans a short story or report by recording its main points in a frame: beginning, middle and end, or headings.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Describe a place or a character
skills.learning_objective: Writes three to five sentences describing a setting or a character, using details of what is seen, heard and felt.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Put words in alphabetical order by the first two letters
skills.learning_objective: Orders words alphabetically by their first and second letters, and uses this to find a word in a dictionary or glossary.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use a contents page and an index
skills.learning_objective: Finds the page for a topic from a contents page or an index, and chooses which one to use.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say what a non-fiction text is for
skills.learning_objective: Identifies whether a non-fiction text instructs, reports, recounts or explains, and finds the features that show it and keep the reader interested.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Name the parts of a text
skills.learning_objective: Identifies titles, headings, paragraphs, chapters, numbered and bulleted lists, verses and stage directions, and says what each is for.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Group sentences that belong together
skills.learning_objective: Sorts sentences about the same idea into one paragraph or section, and chooses a heading for each.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say what a passage is mostly about
skills.learning_objective: Chooses or writes the main point of a passage or paragraph in one sentence, leaving out small details.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use the right topic words
skills.learning_objective: Uses the special words of a familiar topic, such as habitats or food, in the right place in a sentence.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Fill a table from a text
skills.learning_objective: Records information from a passage in a table or labelled diagram, one fact in each box.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find nouns, pronouns, verbs and adjectives
skills.learning_objective: Identifies the nouns, pronouns, verbs and adjectives in a sentence and says what job each does.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use words that say where and when
skills.learning_objective: Uses prepositions of place and time, such as under, behind, during and until, to say exactly where or when.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell compound words and tricky words
skills.learning_objective: Writes compound words by joining two words, and spells tricky words correctly using patterns, memory tricks and saying the parts.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Work out a new word's meaning from the sentence
skills.learning_objective: Chooses the meaning of an unfamiliar word from the clues in the sentence and the sentences around it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find and use words that mean the same
skills.learning_objective: Finds words in a text that mean the same as a given word, and chooses a better synonym for big, small, nice or good.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spot and add describing words
skills.learning_objective: Identifies the adjectives and noun phrases that make a picture for the reader, and adds describing words to a plain noun.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spot and use sound words
skills.learning_objective: Identifies words that sound like the noise they name, and chooses one to fit a sound in a sentence.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Work out what the writer hints at
skills.learning_objective: Explains what a character feels, thinks or wants from clues in what they do and say, when the passage does not say it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say what a story teaches
skills.learning_objective: Identifies the lesson or big idea of a story, such as kindness or honesty, and finds stories that share it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Compare two tellings of one story
skills.learning_objective: Compares two retellings of the same story and finds what stays the same and what changes.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Predict how a story might end
skills.learning_objective: Predicts a story's ending from what has happened and from stories of the same kind, and gives a reason.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Keep verbs in the past or the present
skills.learning_objective: Identifies past and present verbs in a text and writes regular verbs in one tense all the way through.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use irregular past tense verbs
skills.learning_objective: Writes the past tense of common irregular verbs, such as go and went, and matches each to its present form.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Start a sentence with when, where or how
skills.learning_objective: Sorts sentence openers by time, place and manner, and uses one to link a sentence to the one before.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Join two ideas in one sentence
skills.learning_objective: Uses and, but, so, because, when, before, after and if to join two ideas into one sentence that makes sense.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write events in a clear order
skills.learning_objective: Writes four to six sentences that tell events in order, linking them with time words.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Turn a short story part into a playscript
skills.learning_objective: Writes a few lines of a story as a playscript, with each speaker's name, their words and a stage direction.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Put speech marks round spoken words
skills.learning_objective: Finds the words a character says and writes speech marks round them, keeping the narrator's words outside.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Choose a better word than said
skills.learning_objective: Chooses a speech verb, such as whispered or shouted, that shows how something is said, and explains what it adds.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Suggest how to make writing better
skills.learning_objective: Checks a short piece of writing for sense and content and suggests one clear improvement with a better version.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Follow written instructions
skills.learning_objective: Reads written steps, such as a recipe or a puzzle, follows them in order on the paper and shows the result.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Tell a fact from an opinion
skills.learning_objective: Sorts sentences into facts, which can be checked, and opinions, which say what someone thinks.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a short review of a book
skills.learning_objective: Writes a short review that says what a book is about and gives an opinion with a reason.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a question, a command and an exclamation
skills.learning_objective: Writes each kind of sentence for a purpose, such as a command for a recipe or a question for an interview, with the right end mark.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find and fix mistakes in spelling, grammar and punctuation
skills.learning_objective: Finds and corrects the spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes in a short piece of writing.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Read new long words from their parts
skills.learning_objective: Reads an unfamiliar long word by finding its root, prefix and suffix, and uses the sentence to check its meaning.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Hear the strong beat in a long word
skills.learning_objective: Identifies the stressed syllable in a word of two to four syllables, and the weak syllables around it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Read words that look or sound nearly alike
skills.learning_objective: Reads common words at sight and chooses between near-homophones, such as quiet and quite, by meaning.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell words with silent letters and unusual vowel spellings
skills.learning_objective: Writes words with silent letters, the 'o' spelling of the short u sound, and the vowel changes after w.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Make plurals with -s, -es, -ies and -ves
skills.learning_objective: Writes the plural of a noun by adding -s or -es, changing y to ies, or changing f or fe to ves.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell words with trans-, pre-, -ion, -ation and -ous
skills.learning_objective: Writes words with trans-, pre-, -ion, -ation and -ous, changing the root where the rule needs it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Choose there, their or they're
skills.learning_objective: Chooses there, their or they're, and your or you're, by the job the word does in the sentence.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell letter strings said in different ways
skills.learning_objective: Writes words with the same letter string said in different ways, such as -ough, -ou- and -ear, and sorts them by sound.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find a spelling rule and test it
skills.learning_objective: Finds the rule a set of words follows, tests it on new words, and finds the word that breaks it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spell tricky words with rules, parts and memory tricks
skills.learning_objective: Writes unfamiliar regular and tricky words correctly, using syllables, rules, word parts and memory tricks.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find fiction and non-fiction books by their labels
skills.learning_objective: Sorts books into fiction and non-fiction and places a non-fiction book in its section from its subject and label.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Compare kinds of stories by their features
skills.learning_objective: Compares two kinds of story, such as a fable and an adventure, by their characters, settings, plots and language.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find and use information to answer questions
skills.learning_objective: Finds the information a question needs in a longer passage, sometimes from two places, and uses it in the answer.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Show how a character or place is built, with the story's words
skills.learning_objective: Explains how a writer builds a character or setting and quotes the key words and phrases that show it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Name the stages of a text from opening to ending
skills.learning_objective: Places each part of a story or report in its stage: opening, build-up, problem, resolution and ending, or introduction to conclusion.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: End every sentence correctly
skills.learning_objective: Writes the right end mark and capital letter in a run of sentences where the breaks are not shown.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use commas to make meaning clear
skills.learning_objective: Writes commas in lists, after an opening phrase and before a name someone is spoken to, and says how a comma changes the meaning.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Describe a setting or character to catch the reader
skills.learning_objective: Writes a paragraph describing a setting or character with chosen details, senses and comparisons that make the reader want to read on.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a new beginning or ending for a story
skills.learning_objective: Writes a different opening or ending for a known story that fits its characters and what has already happened.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Put words in alphabetical order past the first letters
skills.learning_objective: Orders words alphabetically using the third letter or later when the first letters match, and uses guide words in a dictionary.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use topic words accurately
skills.learning_objective: Uses the special words of a familiar topic accurately, choosing between topic words with close meanings.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Build words from the same root
skills.learning_objective: Sorts words into families with the same root, writes new words from a root and says what the family means.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Pick the key words that give the main points
skills.learning_objective: Finds the key words and phrases in a paragraph that give its main point, leaving out the details.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Skim a text for its overall sense
skills.learning_objective: Reads a text quickly for its gist, using title, headings and first sentences, and chooses what it is mostly about.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Organise ideas into paragraphs and sections
skills.learning_objective: Sorts ideas into paragraphs and sections with headings, and finds the sentence that does not belong.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Name the features of a kind of text
skills.learning_objective: Identifies the features of a poem, playscript, report or set of instructions and uses lists and headings where the text needs them.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Follow how ideas link within and between paragraphs
skills.learning_objective: Finds the words that link one point to the next within and between paragraphs, and says how each new point builds on the last.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Make short notes from a text
skills.learning_objective: Records the key facts of a passage as short notes in a table or list, then uses them to write.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Suggest a synonym for a new word from its sentence
skills.learning_objective: Uses clues in the sentence to suggest a word that means the same as an unfamiliar word.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Collect strong words and replace overused ones
skills.learning_objective: Finds strong words in a text and chooses a better word or phrase for an overused one, such as nice, got or a lot.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Order words by strength of meaning
skills.learning_objective: Orders adjectives and adverbs from weakest to strongest and chooses the one that fits a sentence exactly.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spot and explain similes and alliteration
skills.learning_objective: Identifies similes and alliteration in a text and explains the picture or sound each one makes.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write similes and alliteration
skills.learning_objective: Writes a simile with like or as and a phrase with alliteration to describe something in a fresh way.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Work out hidden meanings about places and characters
skills.learning_objective: Explains what the writer suggests about a setting or a character from clues, and quotes the clue.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Predict what happens next from earlier events
skills.learning_objective: Predicts what happens next in a story and links the prediction to an earlier event in it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Compare the themes of two texts
skills.learning_objective: Compares the themes and features of two texts and finds what they share and where they differ.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say how a story shows its time and place
skills.learning_objective: Finds the details that show when and where a story is set, and explains how life there differs from today.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use past, present and future verb forms
skills.learning_objective: Writes verbs in the past, present and future, keeps a tense steady, and changes tense on purpose inside speech.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Make the subject and the verb agree
skills.learning_objective: Chooses is or are, was or were, and has or have to agree with the subject, in the past, present and future.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Join clauses and paragraphs with connectives
skills.learning_objective: Finds connectives in a text and uses them, such as unless, while, since and so that, to join clauses and to link paragraphs.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write ideas in a logical order with clear links
skills.learning_objective: Writes a paragraph whose ideas follow on in order, showing how each links to the last with connectives.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a short scene of a play
skills.learning_objective: Writes an original short scene for two or three characters with names, lines and stage directions set out as a playscript.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Say who is telling the story
skills.learning_objective: Identifies whether a story is told by a character (I, we) or by a narrator outside it (he, she, they), and finds the words that show it.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Link a story to your own life
skills.learning_objective: Explains a personal response to a character, setting or event and links it to an experience of their own.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Set out and punctuate speech
skills.learning_objective: Writes speech with speech marks, a comma, question mark or exclamation mark inside them, and a new line for a new speaker.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Choose strong verbs and say what they add
skills.learning_objective: Chooses a strong verb in place of a plain one and explains how it changes the picture for the reader.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Plan writing in different ways
skills.learning_objective: Plans writing with the frame that suits it: a story mountain, a mind map, a table or a list of steps.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a character profile
skills.learning_objective: Writes a character profile with looks, personality, likes and a quote, each backed by a detail from the story.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write a character's opinion of a place or person
skills.learning_objective: Writes a few sentences as a character, giving their opinion of a setting or another character and a reason.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Spot how a text tries to persuade
skills.learning_objective: Identifies how an advert or review persuades: strong adjectives, questions to the reader, numbers and promises.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Sort facts from opinions in a longer text
skills.learning_objective: Sorts facts from opinions in a review or advert and identifies the words that mark an opinion, such as best or I think.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Write for a view in a non-fiction text
skills.learning_objective: Writes a short non-fiction text for a reader, such as a note to the principal, that gives a view and two reasons.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use words that say how many or how much
skills.learning_objective: Chooses quantifiers, such as each, every, several, few, many and much, that fit the noun and the meaning.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Find and use adverbs and adverbial phrases
skills.learning_objective: Identifies adverbs and adverbial phrases that say how, when or where, and adds one to make an instruction exact.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Use apostrophes to show who owns something
skills.learning_objective: Writes an apostrophe for one owner and for many owners, such as the girl's bag and the girls' bags.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Proofread and correct a paragraph
skills.learning_objective: Finds and corrects spelling, grammar and punctuation mistakes in a paragraph, including apostrophes and speech.

skills.subject: ENG
skills.name: Evaluate writing and improve it
skills.learning_objective: Checks a piece of writing for sense, accuracy and content and rewrites one part to make it better, saying why.
